title: Anne Hathaway & Ewan McGregor Answer Rapid Fire Questions | Mini Interview | The New Yorker
description:
Anne Hathaway and Ewan McGregor, the stars of “The End of Oak Street,” sit down for a New Yorker Mini Interview where they answer rapid-fire questions—from what food Ewan craves the most when he’s not in Scotland to a film that Anne thinks everyone should watch.

“The End of Oak Street” is in theaters August 14th.
